posts.hook: Anthropic wants $20B in AI compute and permanent control of its own company
posts.caption: anthropic locks in an $11.6b akamai cloud deal and asks shareholders for permanent founder control, bitget loses $351.6m to hackers, and draftkings' bet-scoring ai draws a state investigation. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic locks in a $11.6B Akamai cloud deal
slides.desc: Warrant for up to 5% of Akamai; deal could grow to $20B total

slides.title: Anthropic wants founders to hold ==50.1%== control forever
slides.desc: A Palantir-style structure ahead of a likely IPO

slides.desc: Cold storage untouched; hints point toward Lazarus Group

slides.desc: ==$400M== in bonus bets went to the biggest likely losers in 2025

slides.desc: SalesBleed hijacked leads to phish employees over Slack

slides.title: Zuckerberg says AI labs don't need to coordinate on safety
slides.desc: Comes as rivals name and staff their own safety oversight body

slides.title: Meta wants you to build games by typing a prompt
slides.desc: Horizon Create ships free game tools; Roblox and Unity dipped

posts.hook: A US court just ruled Anthropic's own AI is a security risk
posts.caption: a federal court sides with the pentagon over using claude, one israeli startup turns out to be behind most of this year's rogue ai hacking stories, and ai startups with zero revenue raised $24 billion in two quarters. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
